messages:
maria_fin: Heads up — saw a big spike in west-eu GPU spend overnight due to spot preemptions. Rough total is ~€3.4k above baseline, several customer jobs were auto-migrated to on-demand. Sharing the query output and asking for suggestions on whether we credit teams or absorb under platform buffer.

owen_eng: Thanks, flagged it. I can see a 2h window where the autoscaler drained spot pool and we fell back to reserved for high-memory workloads. Can you paste the BQ rows?

sara_ml: FYI, a couple of retrain jobs from "personalization" retried 3x after preemption, that explains doubled GPU-hours for that team. Suggest we look at retry policy first.

maria_fin: Attaching the query results snippet below (exported CSV). Also ran a quick aggregation by team:
```sql
SELECT team, SUM(gpu_cost_eur) as cost_eur, SUM(gpu_hours) as hours
FROM `billing.gpu_usage`
WHERE region = 'eu-west1' AND DATE(timestamp) = '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY cost_eur DESC
```

maria_fin: Top three teams: personalization €1,900 (11.2h extra), search-relevancy €900 (4.8h), sandbox €600 (2.6h). There are also ~120 preemption events recorded in the same window from our spot-monitor.

ben_ops: Does billing-bot have the link to the raw alerts? billing-bot: can you dump the preemption IDs for that window?

billing-bot: Automated alert dump: https://internal.tools/alerts/exports/2358004321-preemptions.csv — 120 entries, first seen 2026-03-21T02:12Z, last seen 2026-03-21T04:15Z.

owen_eng: Ok. Two follow-ups: 1) Are those jobs using the latest retry-with-backoff? If not, we should ask SRE to update job templates. 2) For billing, if we credit teams, we need a consistent rule (e.g., credit full extra delta when preemption rate > X% and autoscaler fallback occurred).

sara_ml: Agree on a policy. For this incident I vote for a one-off partial credit (50% of incremental cost) because teams also triggered retries. We should also offer guidance to reduce retries.

maria_fin: Proposal: credit 50% of incremental GPU cost to affected teams and charge remaining 50% to platform buffer for Q1 anomalies. Estimated credit pool: €1.7k (split pro-rata by incremental hours). Approving managers: @owen_eng and @ben_ops — please confirm so I can file the adjustment and notify teams.

owen_eng: :thumbsup: I approve the one-off 50% credit. Please include a short notes field in the invoice adjustment stating "spot preemption spike — platform partial credit".

ben_ops: I also approve. Can we add a follow-up action item to update autoscaler fallback thresholds and reduce immediate fallbacks?

maria_fin: Will do. Filing adjustment now and creating a short post-incident doc. I'll DM teams with the breakdown and a link to the remediation checklist. Thanks all.

billing-bot: Adjustment ticket created #BILL-4821. Amount credited: €1,700. Linked postmortem: https://internal.docs/postmortems/BILL-4821-preemptions.
